name: Matterleast
tagline: Team chat that runs on your own server.
about:
Matterleast is a team chat app with channels, direct messages, threads, file sharing and search. It also has tools for a shop: work schedules, time cards and a way to check in a car with photos.

It is self-hosted. Each organization runs its own small server and people use it in a browser or in the iPhone and Android apps. Your data lives on that server, which the developer's own shop runs for its own team. The developer does not run a central service that collects it. The Android app allows device backups that can include the sign-in session, and the apps allow unencrypted connections to servers, so owners should run it only over a private network or HTTPS.

collects.why: Sign-in and showing who is who.

Work schedules, shifts, time clock punches and edits (with reasons), and payroll hours
collects.shared: Server administrators. If an admin sets up a Discord webhook, payroll hours are posted to Discord. An admin can also import from the uAttend time clock service.

collects.what: Photos of work schedules uploaded by an admin
collects.where: On your organization's server. The text is read by Apple's on-device text recognition on the server computer.
collects.shared: Not sent to any outside text recognition service
collects.why: To turn a schedule photo into shifts.

usage_data:
Matterleast records diagnostic logs. On your device the app records a heartbeat every 10 seconds, even when idle. The heartbeat has the current screen, app state, your username, network type, memory, storage and battery level, screen size, app version and a session id. The app also records taps, clicks, scrolls, screen changes, pointer movement, key presses, network errors, app launch and close, and errors with details. The server also logs each request, including the IP address of the requester.

The events are queued on your device and uploaded to the server you sign in to. They are not sent to any analytics company. The server keeps them as daily files for 30 days, capped at about 1 GB. Typed text, message text, passwords, passcodes and login tokens are not logged. Key-press events do not include what was typed. Only a hidden developer area, behind a passcode, can view or download the logs. This is Usage Data in App Store terms, and it is used only for fixing problems. Your device is labeled in logs with a random name such as ios-a1b2c3.
not_collected: No tracking across other apps or websites
No location access, and car check-in photos have GPS data removed
No contacts or Bluetooth access, and no Face ID use
No paid AI service: text recognition and help use Apple's on-device features

third_parties.what: Push tokens and the notification text, which includes the sender's username and the first 180 characters of the message, only if the server owner turned push on.
Encrypted help and can't-reach-the-server reports, only when you tap send.
The server's host name, only during a failed-connection check.
Payroll hours, only if an admin set up a Discord webhook.
Vehicle check-in photos, sent by the shop's helper software.
Matterleast reads time clock data from it when an admin imports it.

third_parties.who: Websites you link to in chat
third_parties.what: The server contacts the link to build a preview.

retention:
Your messages, files, schedules and time cards stay on the organization's server. There is no automatic expiry for them today. The server keeps backups: nightly copies for 30 days and copies made before updates. Diagnostic logs are deleted after 30 days. Unsent attachments are cleaned up daily.

To clear this device, open Settings and choose Erase All Data on This Device. It removes the saved server, your sign-in, drafts, the offline copy, the local log queue and this app's push registration. It does not touch the server or your account.

There is no button to delete your account in the app. An administrator can deactivate an account. To ask about your data, contact your organization's administrator.
children: Matterleast is a workplace tool. Accounts are created by an administrator or an invite link. It is not directed at children.
support_what:
Matterleast is a team chat app that runs on a server your organization owns. People chat in channels, direct messages and threads, share files, and search. It also has work schedules, time cards and a car check-in with photos.

You use it in a web browser or in the iPhone and Android apps.
support_steps: Open the app or web page for your team's chat.
Let the app find your team's server, or enter the server address your administrator gave you.
Sign in with the account your administrator or invite link created.
Allow notifications to get message alerts.
To change servers, use Change server in Settings.

support_faq.q: The app says it can't reach the server. What now?
support_faq.a: Use the Can't reach the server button. It checks the connection and, if you tap send, sends a short report to the developer without using your server. The server may also be down or you may be off its network.

support_faq.q: How do I clear Matterleast from my phone?
support_faq.a: In Settings choose Erase All Data on This Device. It removes local data only. Your account and messages stay on the server.

support_faq.q: How do I delete my account or messages?
support_faq.a: The app has no self-service delete. Ask your organization's administrator.
No. The server stores messages in readable form, and administrators of the server can see them. Connections use HTTPS when the server is reached over https.
Logs are uploaded to your organization's server. They can be viewed only through a hidden developer area behind a passcode.
